title: Specialist Interventions
description: This module equips specialist DFV practitioners with advanced therapeutic and intersectional intervention skills. It focuses on specialist trauma support, working with cultural and contextual complexity, and applying intersectional practice in high‑risk DFV cases.
outcomes: Provide specialist therapeutic support to clients experiencing complex trauma
Work effectively with cultural, linguistic, and contextual complexity in DFV cases
Apply intersectional practice to understand layered barriers and risks
